rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for something whose outcome can be guessed or anticipated.

example.english: What he would do next was predictable; I could tell from the start.
example.traditional: 佢下一步會做乜，我一早估得到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 haa6 jat1 bou6 wui5 zou6 mat1 ngo5 jat1 zou2 gu2 dak1 dou3

rows.note: Use this technical term for patterns, trends, or results that are predictable in an analytical or mathematical sense.

example.english: The results of this model are highly predictable.
example.traditional: 呢個模型嘅結果相當可預測。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 mou4 jing4 ge3 git3 gwo2 soeng1 dong1 ho2 jyu6 caak1
